dedupe_keys.name: iea wind task 31 design of a new comparison metrics simulation challenge for wind resource assessment in complex terrain stage 1

description: Sarah Barber and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The initial Perdigao challenge compares WAsP simulations with previous WRF results. WAsP captures major ridge and valley flow patterns but misses smaller separated-flow features. Further solver comparisons form part of the designed challenge and are not all treated as completed in this source. The conference paper, a poster with the same descriptive content and initial challenge results are grouped as one assessment family. Different file identities and stages remain explicit. The record does not imply that every planned challenge stage or every solver configuration was completed. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
